items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Everybody in the band, we idolized him.

ctx.x: That's one person we haven't talked about.

Billy? Ain't nothing I can tell you about Sweetpea. That's his name, his nickname. Because he was a guy that everybody, all the guys loved him. All the ladies idolized him because he was tiny and all the ladies wanted to mother him. I never saw a little man like that, could go up and stay all night long and cabaret all night long, sick all night long and walk the chuck line. He was amazing. He got me so I hated to look at him. I used to say, man, how you do that? And he would laugh. He would laugh. And Duke loved…
You know when he first came in the band? Not the year, I mean, came in about the late thirties, wasn't it, about 1938 when you all did that piece (humming).
